azure.defender.storage_malware.title: Defender for Storage — on-upload malware scanning: StorageAccounts plan extensions, per-account DefenderForStorageSettings, blob index tags, Storage.Blob_AM.MalwareFound alert
limitations: Honest scanner: SHA-256 hash + literal content signatures (EICAR test string, the Vyomi test string, and signatures the operator registers) over the object and zip members (2 levels, size-capped). It detects the standard test samples and what you register; it is not an antivirus engine (no heuristics, behavioural analysis or vendor threat intelligence). Scans run synchronously on upload and only cover NEW uploads (no on-demand scan of existing data); objects over 64 MiB are reported unsupported/not scanned.

Blob index tags are supported for get/set (?comp=tags and x-ms-tags) but there is no tag-based blob query (find blobs by tags). The scan-results Event Grid topic is stored but no event is delivered. Sensitive data discovery is stored, not run.
